name: Blonde Espresso Roast
description: Experience the lighter side of espresso—a soft, beautifully balanced flavor profile that pairs perfectly with milk (or your favorite nondairy alternative). Made up of select Latin American and East African beans, this blend is carefully roasted to coax out sweet, vibrant notes of candied apple and bittersweet chocolate. The result is smooth, well-rounded and versatile, delicious served hot or over ice.

rating.description: As for the coffee I use for cold brew, it uses a LOT of beans, so I use what ever is on special offer in the supermarket. For my Aeropress and my moka pot I’m rather fond of Starbucks Blonde Espresso beans, but I do also like to mix it up to keep things interesting. I end up going Starbucks, something else, Starbucks, something else, Starbucks…

name: Kagoshima Green Tea
description: A classic blend of genmaicha and matcha teas, Matcha Toasted Rice has a savory, nutty flavor. We blend sencha green tea with toasted rice to make Genmaicha, a traditional Japanese tea. The result is a smooth, rich brew with earthy depth and undertones of brightness.

rating.description: Is it the world's most exquisite green tea? No. Could you get better green tea? Yes. Do I like this? Yes, I do. I will have this tea again. It's so easy to make and quite comforting.

name: Kagoshima Green Tea
description: One of the best Senchas from the Kagoshima area in southern Japan, this brew is light in the cup with a good balance of sweet and bitter flavors.

rating.description: I grew up on Kagoshima green tea, and this is a pretty good one. I might need to experiment with the brewing a bit, but overall, very satisfying.

name: Pineapple, Guava, Passion Radler
description: The most refreshing beer style for fun in the sun. The Radler was invented for crowds of German cyclists and we’re sharing our beer and fruit blends for whatever you’re up to this summer.

rating.description: A rather weak, not so flavorful beer.

name: Melon Cart
description: Tastes like freshly cut melons and the California sun right in your hand. This light, crisp Wheat Ale is bursting with watermelon, honeydew, and cantalope flavors, finishing bright and refreshing.

rating.description: This one is a whopping 4% alcohol. I enjoyed this more than I expected to. Now I think this has more flavor than the Guava Cart.

name: Grapefruit
description: Schöfferhofer Grapefruit is the unique combination of sparkling smooth Schöfferhofer unfiltered wheat beer with natural grapefruit flavoured drink. A refreshing, well-rounded taste with tangy character and hints of sweetness is pleasing to palate.

rating.description: A definite thumbs-up, one of my repeats. It is well-rounded and pleasing, just like they say.

name: Blackbird Stout
description: Our newest year-round release, a long-awaited stout! Blackbird Stout is brewed with malted millet and malted rice for a dark, earthy, roasty flavor. An instant favorite. Brewed with malted millet, malted rice, hops, yeast, and water.

rating.description: Not the best gluten-free beer I've had... A little thin, a little bitter. Wanted to like it but I can't recommend it.

name: Triple Fruited Tripel
description: A fruited feast for the senses. Delightful aromas of ripe peach, creamy mango and juicy orange, with a hint of carbonation to tickle the nose. Three fruits, three times added to a balance blend of citrusy hops makes each sip more refreshing than the last. Well-complimented by a vibrant ginger hue and sitting nicely at 9% ABV, Triple Fruited Tripel makes for an easy drinking ale that's juicy and smooth.

rating.description: A mere 9.0% alcohol. Probably my favorite brewery and a nice strong fruity beer.

name: Nayo Ovalle
description: Look for well-rounded notes of orange, almond butter, and milk chocolate in the cup.

rating.description: Coava is probably my favorite current roaster, and this is another smooth blend. Yes! Recommend!

name: Salted Caramel Porter
description: A lightly-roasted, mahogany-colored, medium-bodied malt that is as smooth as a Marvin Gaye love song. With a sweet, salted-caramel flavor, this special porter is a delicious ale you’ll want to enjoy over and over.

rating.description: This is a great porter. It's only 5.8%, which is great, and it's tasty and smooth. Drink it!

name: Chai Love Spiced Chai Black Tea
description: Spiced Chai black tea, high caffeine.

rating.description: Chai with black tea. Lovely! The cardamom is hitting me hard.

name: S.O. Blend
description: Top quality specialty coffees from East Africa, Central, & South America offer caramel sweetness, chocolate layered with complex fruit notes, and crisp acidity. This tried and true coffee is the kind of cup you want to drink every day. Rich. Chocolatey.

rating.description: Like all Coava coffees, it's smooth and mellow and I love it. Another great one for pour overs.

name: Costa Rica Santa Maria De Dota
description: One of our favorite coffees here at Backporch and a coffee we have been purchasing for about a decade now. This coffee staple at Backporch is sweet, winey, chocolatey, citrusy and delicious. Cupping Notes: Clean Orange Citrus, Milk Chocolate and Winey.

rating.description: I love all the Backporch coffees, and this is no exception. Will drink again.

name: DUNKIN’ BLUEBERRY MATCHA IPA
description: Brand new for 2021, this hazy IPA is inspired by Dunkin’s Blueberry Matcha Latte. Brewed with blueberries, Dunkin’ matcha, and a blend of traditional and modern hops, it’s both tea-like and tropical with bright, juicy notes of mixed berry. Available only in the Dunkin’ Dozen Mix Pack!

rating.description: This is a beer. This may be the only IPA I've ever thought actually tasted good. A seasonal brew from two home teams with blueberries and matcha.

name: Marryin' Berries
description: Made for the assistant brewer's wedding this kettle sour is made with white wheat, flaked oats, marrionberries, raspberries, and mosaic.

rating.description: SOUR! Berries! Ex Novo! What's not to love? (Answer: their crappy website) Their beer is amazing though.

name: Backporch Blend
description: This is a favored staple here at Backporch. Syrupy and sweet, with hints of dark chocolate, cherries, cane sugar and caramel.

rating.description: Very smooth and nice. Easy to brew, easy to drink.

name: The Darkness
description: The Darkness is bigger and bolder than anything you've had before. It celebrates a heavy, syrupy body, making it the perfect choice for a hard-hitting espresso with a full flavour of vanilla, almond and dark chocolate.

rating.description: I was drawn in by the package. I taste the richness, but calling it chocolatey is a stretch. It is bitter but it is smooth. A bit of a slap in your face kind of coffee, which is kind of what I need in the morning. Not too bad in all.

name: French Roast Dark
description: Intense and smoky, the pure, explosive flavor of French Roast is as dark as our dark roasts get.

rating.description: A dark french roast best made as an espresso.

name: Silver Imperial
description: La cerveza de los costarricenses desde 1924

rating.description: All Imperial beers are in the 4% ABV range.

name: Third Bird Oatmeal Stout
description: Smooth and soft, with subtle notes of coffee and chocolate, this oatmeal stout is a fine choice for any time of day, whether you're an early bird or a night owl. 6.0% ABV

rating.description: A really nice smooth Oatmeal Stout that I will absolutely buy again.

name: Guava Cart
description: A light & refreshing wheat ale made with real guava.

rating.description: Not as sweet as Mango Cart, but higher alcohol. It has a nice guava flavor and the slightest hint of bitterness at the very end. Not unpleasant like most IPAs though.

name: Peanut Butter Milk Stout
description: Troy came up with the idea of combining the flavor of peanut butter with our milk stout and he nailed it. Don’t let the dark color fool you, this beer is delightfully easy to drink with cascading aromas of roasted peanuts, dark chocolate and coffee. Good times to you my friend, and welcome to the beaver family!

rating.description: This is the best peanut butter milk stout I've found. Very slightly bitter, but it is a favorite and I have purchased it multiple times. It does not make me belch, and I'm not a beaver, even though I do live in the Pacific Northwest.

name: Wonderland Winter Blend
description: The perfect cozy blend for misty mornings. Medium roast, wonderfully balanced with festive tasting notes of baking spice, brown sugar and toasted nuts.

rating.description: Not necessarily in my top five of coffees, but I will and did buy this again. It's easy to make a smooth cup of coffee with this roast, and it's a nice drinking morning coffee.

name: Distant Horizon Whole Bean Coffee
description: Bold with notes of dark chocolate. Blend of beans from Colombia, Brazil, Ethiopia and Nicaragua. From Crop to Cup: Sourced and Roasted with Care.

rating.description: I like it a lot. I had 3 cups in one day, and I didn't put any cream in, which I normally do with coffee.

name: San Marcos Honduras
description: Look for a sweet and balanced profile with notes of stewed pear, brown sugar, and baker's chocolate in the cup.

rating.description: This one grew on me. It's nice and mellow, mellower than I expected, but a very nice one.

name: Slow Motion
description: For Slow Motion, we start by selecting the same high-quality coffees that appear in our other offerings and gently decaffeinate them in small batches using organic processing. Tasting notes: Smooth molasses and cocoa.

rating.description: Tasty, a tiny bit more acidic than I like, but definitely a drinkable coffee that I will buy again.

name: Sunbreak Morning Blend
description: With notes of chocolate and nuts, this is an ideal coffee when you need to satisfy a wide range of coffee drinkers. Family gathering with some crusty bugger demanding darkness and your fancy people from PDX who will not tolerate bitterness except well… never mind.

rating.description: I do love me a good Trailhead, and this is a nice mellow one.

name: Gingerbread Flavored Tea
description: Limited Edition. Our Food You Feel Good About yellow banner is your shortcut to great-tasting products with no artificial colors, flavors or preservatives.

rating.description: A black tea with caramel notes. It has a very smooth mouth feel to it.

name: Sleigh'r Winter Ale
description: A limited release. Roasty, Toffee, Malty.

rating.description: Winter ales tend to be ever so slightly bitter, and this one fits that mold, but it's pretty good. I do taste the roasty, toffee, malty flavor they claim. I wouldn't fight an angry mob for it, but it is worth drinking.

name: Study Hall
description: Study Hall is a classic Amber ale conditioned on Maple Coffee roasted by Speeder & Earls. Flavors and aromas of Maple candy, French Roast Cold Brew, Caramel, Toffee, and Maple frosted Coffee Cake.

rating.description: Lighter than the Burlington Beer Co. Moccacino, but very, very good.

name: Breakfast Blend
description: Notes of sweet orange and brown sugar mingle in our lightest medium roast coffee.

rating.description: It’s more about the French Press and less about the coffee.

name: Red
description: Deep dark red colour, with a light pink, compact and lacing head. Soft fruity aroma, with hints of almond and mildly sour cherries. Sweet and fruity, with a nice balance between sweet and sour. An excellent dessert beer.

rating.description: A little too sweet, a little too much like drinking cherry syrup

name: White
description: The Original Belgian Wheat Beer. Almost 600 years ago in the Belgian village of Hoegaarden, a band of monks experimented by adding oddball botanicals from halfway around the world to their traditional wheat beer. Our recipe, inspired by their creation, is a beer with a refreshing flavor and captivating aroma, unlike any in the world. Let the refreshing citrus and earthy coriander alleviate the stresses of modern living and whisk you to another place entirely. You might call it divine inspiration... we call it Hoegaarden.

rating.description: It’s a touch weak and a lot wheat.

name: Santa's Private Reserve Honey Mama's
description: Santa has always been convinced that all great confections come from the North Pole, so we reached out to our friends at Honey Mama’s to help us show him otherwise. The Honey Mama’s crew whipped up some of their favorite tasty treats and we sent them up to Santa in a care package. It’s safe to say he feels a bit differently now, for mere minutes after receiving the delivery Santa was on the phone with us gushing about the delicious goodies, begging us to recreate this in his annual Private Reserve. Per his request. we teamed up with Honey Mama’s to create this tahini, tangerine and chocolate flavored stout. Santa is sure to love it. and so are you.

rating.description: Quite good, much better than last year's Santa's Private Reserve. I enjoy it even though I probably won't buy it again.

name: Festivale
description: It’s raining outside, the fireplace is lit, and you’ve just finished the book you’ve been reading for awhile. A family member comes in and asks if you want a Festivale. Could you really say no? Festivale is a classic TG rendition of a Winter Warmer. Brewed to be fairly dry, yet highly drinkable. With a complex malt and hop profile and a full, rounded, deep ruby colored body- Festivale is a winter favorite that rings true to a wide variety of beer drinkers.

rating.description: It's a good festive ale. Festivale!! I actually like this one, but it's not one I see myself drinking a lot of. Thumbs up, but I won't actively seek it out again.

name: Oktoberfest
description: Dedicating the world’s biggest public festival to beer might seem silly to some, but we Germans are very serious about that – as serious as we are about our limited Warsteiner Oktoberfest Special Edition. This beer is brewed with hand-selected hops, Munich-type spring barley malt and extra-soft brewing water from the Arnsberg forest nature park. Its well-balanced taste will make you feel like you are part of the Oktoberfest, wherever you are.

rating.description: It’s like if a light beer married a German. It wasn’t that great, but not that bad either. Not my first go-to Oktoberfest, but I would drink it even if not desperate.

name: BeachLife POG Pale Ale
description: Beach Life P.O.G Pale Ale is a tropical twist on a classic Pale Ale. Brewed with Amarillo, Cascade, and Idaho 7 hops, these fruit-forward aroma hops, and a moderate dose of P.O.G. “Passionfruit, Orange, and Guava” lend to this very drinkable fruit-forward P.O.G. Pale Ale! The first sip will have you living your beach life and take you to the islands with your toes in the sand.

rating.description: When I saw the can, I had mixed feelings, just like the mix of fruit inside this beer. But I like it! It's good! I'll drink more!

name: Single Track
description: Single Track is our single origin rotating espresso at Backporch. For this Single Track we chose a coffee from Antigua Guatemala under the name of Hunapu. Coffees from Antigua have depth and sweetness going for them, as well as some nice fruited notes. We found this coffee to have notes of: dried fig, cacao nibs and molasses. This coffee is suitable for both espresso and filter.

rating.description: For some reaon I was pessimistic about this becuase I bought it when Whole Foods was out of Trailhead. But I really, really like it! It's smooth and mellow and it's very easy to brew without acidity or overly strong flavor. Do recommend.

name: Subtle Beauty
description: Most high end coffees are like a musical soloist with other musicians in the background where the soloist is the important part. This coffee breaks from that formula where there’s no stand out berry note or chocolate note or aroma of Jasmine. Instead it’s just a lovely balanced cup with autumnal mojo happening. We’re getting aroma notes of: Date, Pecan Roll and Cinnamon Toast. In the cup, we’re tasting Apricot, Pie Crust and Brown Sugar. This coffee is worthy of precise brewing and experimentation. Pay special attention to how this coffee cools as the flavors shift delightfully.

rating.description: Trailhead is one of my favorite local roasters, and this is a very nice mellow roast. I love the lighter brown, non-greasy beans, and this has those plus nice easy flavor.

name: Decaf Espresso Whole Bean Roast
description: Bold, decaffeinated dark roast coffee that is smooth with notes of dark chocolate, cocoa and spice. 100% Arabica coffee, sourced and roasted with care to deliver a delightful coffee experience in every cup. Perfect for espresso shot and espresso based drinks.Our Food You Feel Good About yellow banner is your shortcut to great-tasting products with no artificial colors, flavors or preservatives.

rating.description: This is the best store brand decaf coffee I have had the pleasure of sipping. I only wish they sold it in 5 pound bags.

name: Hell or High Watermelon
description: Hell or High Watermelon Wheat is our summer seasonal beer available from April through September in six pack cans and on draft. We start by brewing a classic American wheat beer, then add fresh melons for a straw-colored, delicious beer with a kiss of watermelon aroma and flavor.

rating.description: A  crisp, refreshing wheat beer infused with watermelon.
I wish it had more watermelon flavor, but it is a nice light wheat beer that's very pleasant.

name: Green State Lager
description: A crisp, easy drinking Pilsner beer. Noble hops in perfect balance with only the finest Pilsner malt provide a clean and satisfying brew that is as welcoming as the Green State itself.

rating.description: After you drink all of this beer, you can fly because you experience zero gravity.

name: Walk the Lime
description: Made with Tennessee wheat. This crisp, tropical and refreshing ale is bursting with fresh lime aromas and flavors of zested citrus and bitter peel, mixing perfectly with a clean wheat-driven finish.

rating.description: A very fun summer ale. If you've ever had a Bud Light lime and wished it was good, this is it! A very tasty refreshing wheat ale.

name: Olallie Ale
description: You can if it’s your destiny, and this beer was destined to be canned. Brewed with blackberries, rosehips and Crystal hops, Olallie was designed from the ground up to be our first canned beer. This crisp, dry, well-balanced, refreshing ale is enjoyable any time of the year. Fun Fact: Olallie is Chinook Jargon for berry.

rating.description: A gluten-free blackberry and rosehip ale. A very fruity drink. I do like these. It's very good.

name: Thresh
description: To allow for this special grain to shine, we brewed a Pale Lager with just a touch of modern flair, achieved with a very subtle dry-hop of Motueka. The gentle hop addition offers a fleeting highlight of key lime and zested citrus, with some floral undertones adding complexity.

rating.description: Pretty good. Not super hoppy, not super bitter, and it is a lager.

name: The Most Interesting Lager In The World
description: Crisp and refreshing, brewed with Saaz hops, Vienna and Pilsner malts, and a hint of flaked corn.

rating.description: A very good Mexican lager that's great with anything.

name: The Rose
description: Our best seller! A rich, golden color with the spicy aroma of clove and candy banana. The Belgian yeast shines bright on the palate, light and silky, with a clean, slightly drying bitter finish. Pairs well with afternoons on the lake; spring fare, white fish and fruit.

rating.description: Created, not made. My wife's go-to beer.

name: Lights Out Stout
description: Our ode to starry, starry nights. Hints of vanilla, coffee & nutty flavors with a creamy finish.

rating.description: A 7.7% alcohol. I like this. Notes of coffee, chocolate, and vanilla, and I'm like this sounds good, but it was the 30 IBUs that sold me.
A nice dark one that I enjoyed very much. Don't let the hops graphic on the can fool you, it's not too hoppy at all.

name: Oat Soda
description: Bohemian-Style Pilsner brewed with malted and flaked oats and our favorite German pilsner malt along with Czech Saaz Hops. The oats add body and allow us to bring the abv down to supremely crushable levels while the Czech Saaz hops build in the right amount of bitterness and spice to keep it complex and oh so satisfying! Na zdravi!

rating.description: This is ok. It's not the worst beer I've ever had. It's definitely a light beer. I might run 5k out of my way for this beer but not 50k.
Have you ever had a pilsner that was better than just ok? I think that Pilsners are a nice beer for a pizza, but not a beer you would just grab.

name: Run Wild IPA
description: Run Wild is the ultimate sessionable IPA for craft beer lovers. Brewed with a blend of five Northwest hops, it has an approachable bitterness to balance the specialty malt body. Always refreshing and only 65 calories.

rating.description: Dear God. Why??? Tastes like desperate regret. This thing makes me want to spit it out, like poison.

name: Puff Puff Passionfruit Sour
description: Tart, tropical fruit, & juicy hops. Brewed with Mosaic and Simcoe hops, and fermented with passion fruit.

rating.description: OMG is it ever sour, but VERY good.

name: Weizen-Radler
description: This mix is in a class of its own – combining the great taste of Paulaner Hefe-Weizen with natural effervescent lemonade in a non-alcoholic alternative for refreshingly fruity yet malty taste. The citrus notes of lime, orange, and lemon match the wheat beer perfectly and provide a uniquely balanced taste experience.

rating.description: A German non-alcoholic beer. Tastes way more than twice as good as the Run Wild IPA. Tastes like drinking a soda or a lemonade.

name: Big Wave Golden Ale
description: Paddle into easy-drinking, island refreshment with Big Wave. So smooth, it’s like catching the crest of a breaking wave at Oahu’s Makaha Beach and gliding all the way into the sandy shore. Paradise is just a sip away, so bring your ohana along for the ride. One life, right?

rating.description: A light ale that tastes like summer and reinforces my friendly feelings towards Kona Brewing.

name: Salvator
description: Paulaner’s brewing history begins with this beer. It was the Paulaner monks who invented this unfiltered bottom-fermented double bock. This beer has been brewed for over 375 years – always adhering to the original recipe, with only a few refinements over the years.

rating.description: Made in Munich by Monks. I'm just trying to think when was the last time I had a beer from Munich that I did not like, and I can't think of any. This one is good!

name: Catamount Porter
description: Our modern revival of the Vermont classic, Catamount Porter boasts a robust smooth character and a roasty-sweet aroma with notes of dark coffee.

rating.description: A nice porter continued under the Catamount label after Catamount Brewery was acquired by Harpoon Brewery.

name: Milagro Oscuro
description: Nothing, because we don't even have our individual beers listed on our website. 🤷

rating.description: Apparently a limited release, it's a nice dark beer that Ex Novo calls a Mexican style lager.

name: Kona Classic Pipeline
description: We say nothing, because this beer isn't listed on our website anymore. 🤷

rating.description: A very nice coffee porter that's dark enough but still easy to drink. No overpowering porter taste.

name: Son of Juice IPA
description: Bursting with notes of tropical fruit, Son of Juice features loads of Mosaic, Mosaic Cryo, Simcoe, Simcoe Cryo, and Nugget hops. Pilsner malt and oats lend to a soft body and some haze, making for a juicy, low-bitterness IPA.

rating.description: It's an IPA. I was going to say I don't hate it, but then the aftertaste kicked in.

name: Golden Monkey
description: Named in part from the golden tips, our Golden Monkey black tea hails from Fujian Province in China where it is traditionally crafted using sun withering, rolling, fermentation, and drying. The tea is strong bodied, with hints of cocoa, malt, and caramel.

rating.description: I love black tea and Chinese teas in general, and this has a nice strong flavor that I really enjoy. I imagine this would be amazing on a cold, rainy night.

name: Tennessee Sipper Golden Light Ale
description: A back to basics beer; smooth and easy-drinking one. Light-bodied, slightly sweet on the backend, and creamy, this beer is an all day crusher.

rating.description: A lighter ale.

name: Mocaccino
description: Mocaccino is a Blond Stout brewed with Coffee, Chocolate, Vanilla, and Milk Sugar. This ale creates a juxtaposition of flavors to appearance. What looks like a light colored pale ale, is actually a beer rich with flavors and aromas of Espresso, Melted Chocolate Bars, and Vanilla Frosting.

rating.description: A blond milk stout with chocolate, coffee, vanilla, and milk sugar. This may very well be my favorite beer.

name: Milk Stout Nitro
description: Experience America’s Stout. Milk Stout Nitro is a full sensory experience. Gaze at the mesmerizing cascade of all those tiny Nitro bubbles. Breathe in the aromas of roasted coffee, milk chocolate, brown sugar and vanilla cream. Savor the super smooth Nitro sensation. And, smile as the perfectly pillowy head coats your upper lip. This portable draft beer experience is Good to Go straight from the can or served Like a Pro in a glass. From the bottle, Pour Hard to release the Nitro magic inside.

rating.description: I can taste the milk in this. Very smooth.

name: Santa's Private Reserve 2021
description: Santa has always been convinced that all great confections come from the North Pole, so we reached out to our friends at Honey Mama’s to help us show him otherwise. The Honey Mama’s crew whipped up some of their favorite tasty treats and we sent them up to Santa in a care package. It’s safe to say he feels a bit differently now, for mere minutes after receiving the delivery Santa was on the phone with us gushing about the delicious goodies, begging us to recreate this in his annual Private Reserve. Per his request. we teamed up with Honey Mama’s to create this tahini, tangerine and chocolate flavored stout. Santa is sure to love it. and so are you.

rating.description: The fact that it was aged on rum barrel chips is apparent when you drink it, and I don't think that's necessarily a good thing.

name: Everything Nice
description: Lightly dusted with spices of the season, Everything Nice is a warming, wintry Belgian-style blonde ale. This supremely cozy confection pairs perfectly with any traditional holiday treat. Note the flavors of cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, cloves, and white pepper as you sip next to the fireplace. We hope this fresh-baked offering brings warmth and light to you and yours.

rating.description: I am in love. This smells like an amazing Indian curry, tastes like a strong belgian ale, and it finishes like gingerbread.

name: Hefeweizen
description: We'll never tell you what we say about this beer, because it's not currently on our website!

rating.description: A good beer for a sunny, summer day.

name: Jam Sesh
description: You'll just have to guess! Why? Currently not on our website!

rating.description: This is a very good one. A blond ale with strawberries.

name: Vanilla Porter
description: Aromas of vanilla and toasted grain set the stage for mellow flavors of vanilla and dark roasted malts in this popular porter. Don't let its deep mahogany color fool you, this brew is packed with flavor, yet as smooth as they come.

rating.description: A good - not too bitter - porter for a cold day.

name: Otis Oatmeal Stout
description: With a simple call, Oatis will come running, whenever you’re in need of a dependable sidekick by your side. Savor its rich, chocolate, and roasty notes and let it warm your soul. Chocolate. Roasty. Rich.

rating.description: A nice smooth oatmeal stout. In my opinion, the best beer Ninkasi offers.

name: Cactus Wins The Lottery
description: We were about forty miles from Corrales when the Berliner Weisse began to take hold. We can’t stop here, this is Prickly Pear Country.

rating.description: A nice sour, light beer that is very appropriate for summer or anytime you want to pretend it's summer.

name: Mango Cart
description: First in a series inspired by the iconic fruit cart vendors of Los Angeles. A light Wheat Ale bursting with lots of fresh mango flavor and aroma, finishing crisp and refreshing.

rating.description: Good enough that I looked it up in the local store and bought a 15-pack.

name: Newport Daze
description: The morning after a long night, we like to hit the beach for some R&R. Newport Daze Hazy Pale Ale is the perfect day sipper for such an occasion. It’s an easy, mellow brew to get you through. This hazy pale gives off aromas of pineapple & stone fruit, features tangerine & peach flavors, and finishes off slightly sweet and very smooth.

rating.description: More tropical, more citrusy. I can taste a little bit of the hops. Not my favorite Rogue beer.

name: Project Pilsner Crystal
description: Our beer is great, but our website isn't. You'll never find any information about this beer there or anywhere else.

rating.description: I like it. I won't fight an angry mob for it, but it's very smooth and easy to drink.

name: Apricot Wheat
description: Our smooth wheat beer is light in color and body…perfect for those looking for a lighter taste. The combination of wheat and barley gives Apricot Wheat a different malt character than our other ales. The hint of apricot gives this beer a pleasant nose and fruity finish.

rating.description: Less sweet than the mango cart, but it's a very good lighter wheat. Tastes much more like apricot than wet dog, and that is a good thing.

name: Vanishing Point Pale Ale
description: For our take on the classic American pale ale, we decided to throw inhibition to the wind and jump in with both feet. With several types of artisan gluten-free millet & rice malts, and four varieties of Washington-grown hops, one sip will make your preconceptions about gluten-free beer Vanish into the great beyond! A balanced beer with malt flavors of caramel and biscuit with classic American hop flavors of stone fruit and citrus.

rating.description: A little hoppy. Not a repeater for me.

name: Honey Kolsch
description: Brewed with wildflower honey, this Kolsch-style ale has layers of subtle floral notes accented by the honey’s natural sweetness that create a refreshing balance with the hops and malts. Honey Kolsch is our liquid ode to bees for all the wonderful work they do to keep the cycle of life turning.

rating.description: A nice light summery beer that's popular with the whole family (but maybe keep it away from the kids).

name: Summer Love Golden Ale
description: In the late 2000’s we created a beer to celebrate all the best of summer - baseball, beach days, and barbecues. Today, that beer has grown into the most iconic seasonal beer ever and the official craft beer of summer - Summer Love. Summer Love is a refreshing Golden Ale that delivers big flavor through its fine balance of clean pilsner malts and citrusy, earthy Simcoe and Tettnang hops.

rating.description: It is good. Love at first sip.

name: Three Philosophers Double Chocolate
description: It’s been said that chocolate is happiness you can eat. Likewise, we contend that Three Philosophers, our Belgian-style quadruple, is wisdom you can drink. Married together, we present a beer for mind and soul; a deeply-considered chocolate philosophy. For this project, we partnered with the artisans at Taza Chocolate, who shared their cocoa and their expertise in pursuit of sweet perfection. Swirl, sip, and melt away… This heavenly confection pours a deep caramel in color with mahogany flecks, topped by a foamy tan head. Semi-sweet cocoa and subtle vanilla prevail in the aroma. The mouthfeel is textured and full-bodied, with caramel, toffee and dark fruit wrapped in the embrace of rich, decadent Taza chocolate, culminating in a refreshingly smooth, lingering finish.

rating.description: Best drunk at around 50F. One of my favorite beers of all time. It's also a commitment because it's a 9% ABV beer.

name: Fivepine Chocolate Porter
description: A robust Porter that features two pounds per barrel of the finest Belgian dark chocolate, creating a slightly roasty pint with underlying chocolate sweetness.

rating.description: One of my favorite chocolate beers. Someone once asked me if it wasn't too chocolatey, to which I replied, "You understand that I'm drinking this by choice, right?".
